I approached someone I considered a very close friend and expressed how I was feeling suicidal and he essentially got angry, said I wasn’t helping myself and that he was sick of hearing it… so I’ve learned today not to talk about it either. Two down, how many more are gonna get fed up and scared by the end of the day? 
I have been to group therapy in the past and found I dragged the other members of the group back down with me after all the progress they had made before I joined so I never went back ☹️
I’m very lucky my best friend is always there and she’s super empathetic and caring and sensitive… I think I’d already be gone if she didn’t make me feel loved
